thread:
Jana (CS): Ran an onboarding healthcheck for Arbora Systems — baseline notes: p95 tail latency up ~12% over 48h, monthly inference cost +18%, low growth signal on usage. Renewal in Q3 looks soft. Proposing proactive ops: 1) try int8 quantized variant for chat_small, 2) hybrid routing (low-latency route for short prompts, cost route for long), 3) enable prefix/KV caching for common prompt prefixes. Want a quick triage + a canary plan and a customer enablement note. Thoughts?

Ravi (ML Eng): Agree on int8 candidate — should reduce token cost significantly. Need to run perf + quality sweep on Arbora's prompt set. Can carve out a 5% canary with gpt-chat-3b-int8-rc1. Will validate p50/p95, token throughput, and a small QA eval for generation drift.

Nora (Solutions): I can own the customer-facing enablement. I'll ask Arbora to share ~20 representative prompts and clarify SLA sensitivity. I can draft a short deck: savings, latency impact, rollback plan.

Eli (SRE): For routing: recommend policy -> prefer low-latency endpoint for requests with input_tokens < 128, otherwise route to cost-optimized pool. We'll need to tune max_batch_size and batching_timeout to keep p95 in check. I'll put together a canary rollout config and rollback runbook.

Jana (CS): Awesome. Can we get the quant perf check by EOD tomorrow so we can propose numbers in the renewal playbook? I'll also capture customer feedback after the enablement call — want a short form.

Ravi (ML Eng): I can run benches tonight; will post results here. Quick note: int8 may slightly change generation variance — include sample evals and a few reference responses to show no user-facing regression.

DeployBot: deploy-bot: Canary started for Arbora — model=gpt-chat-3b-int8-rc1, traffic=5%, canary_id=canary-7258004321

Nora (Solutions): Scheduled enablement call Tue 10:00am PT, invited Arbora PM + eng. I'll attach the deck and ask for prompt set before the call.

Jana (CS): I'll draft the renewal note: projected monthly savings est ~22%, expected latency delta (p50 ~unchanged / p95 +10-15ms), fallback SLA statements. Will loop in Finance for a light committed-capacity offer if they like the numbers.

Eli (SRE): Added rollback snippet to the runbook (internal):
```
# rollback rule (canary)
if error_rate > 2% or p95_increase > 25%: rollback_to(previous_model)
```
I'll drop the doc link here once I finalize.

Ravi (ML Eng): Posted early bench summary: int8 reduces avg cost per token ~20%, p95 latency for long sequences improved due to smaller memory pressure, small increase in top-k diversity on some prompts (no safety flags). Full numbers coming in next update.

Jana (CS): Perfect — once we have bench numbers I'll prepare the renewal play with the slide deck + opt-in offer. Nora, please capture Arbora feedback during the call and paste highlights here. If Arbora is price-sensitive we push the committed-capacity option.

Nora (Solutions): Will do. Also noting action items: (1) Ravi -> canary perf + eval, (2) Eli -> rollout config + rollback doc, (3) Jana -> renewal play draft, (4) Nora -> enablement deck + prompt collection.

Jana (CS): Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks.
